name: Wehrheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Wehrheim (a yellow lion and a black letter W on red).
history: Municipal flag of Wehrheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wehrheim arms — lion and letter W on red
